verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs show you can create workflows to automate processes, and sequences send a series of timed emails, so automation exists. Nothing in the pack shows recurring or cron-style scheduling of jobs or workflows, or any way to trigger or schedule them through the API, CLI or MCP. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled workflow triggers, programmatic (API/agent) scheduling of workflows, details on schedule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
